title: The Parish of Bellwether Lane
author: Emrys Dunmore
blurb: Rafael Hartwell, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the tide gives up what it took.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
